class.name: humanoid_transport_mujoco/MujocoActuatorTransport
class.description: MuJoCo SIL transport. Applies MIT tuple as joint torque via qfrc_applied. Lockstep stepping: 5 substeps of 1 ms per 5 ms control cycle. Selected by setting transport_plugin to "humanoid_transport_mujoco/MujocoActuatorTransport" in hardware YAML.
